description: Verification harness and documentation: update existing suites for the user decisions (29/36, grading notes hidden, registration password, no tempPassword on activation), add api-account, api-audit, browser-account and browser-audit suites, extend run-all.mjs, then update README.md, database/README.md and .be-tmp/report.md. Depends on FEAT-001..003. Read plan2.md sections 8 and 9.
steps: .be-tmp/verify/lib.mjs appEnv: add CHANGE_PW_RATE_MAX '1000'. Add a small helper for scanning responses/rows for secrets (bcrypt /\$2[aby]\$/, JWT /eyJ[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]+/, captured temp passwords).

Update existing suites: api-student.mjs (lines ~46 and ~209: 34 -> 29 and '29 / 36'; add grading-note checks: no kind 'grading' in /student/home, RM-06 body absent from every student GET, fresh grading remark inserted by SQL also hidden, instructor endpoints still show grading notes), browser-student.mjs (lines ~40 and ~65: 29; no 'Grading note' chip; profile change-password dialog), plus every suite that registers a member (api-public, api-admin-desk, api-admin-business, api-sqli, browser-login, browser-admin-desk) so payloads carry password/confirmPassword and activation assertions no longer expect tempPassword. Do not weaken any existing assertion.

New .be-tmp/verify/api-account.mjs: public + desk (+hold) registration with password end to end, strength rejections, hash cleared after activation/rejection, member signs in with member no and with email, password/hash never in any response, fallback for the seeded demo applications, must_change_password flow for instructor and front desk and student (SQL-set flag), PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED on other endpoints, change-password for student/instructor/front desk/BA (success, new cookie, wrong current, reuse, weak, mismatch, 401, 415), BA reset sets the flag and invalidates old cookie, rate limit in a second app instance with CHANGE_PW_RATE_MAX=5, audit rows for auth.* and staff.password_reset.

New .be-tmp/verify/api-audit.mjs: one assertion per action in plan2.md section 6 (row exists with the right action, actor, entity, summary), rollback leaves no row, secrets scan over every audit_log row (details keys/values and summaries), trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE (via pg client), endpoint auth matrix (401/403/200 for list and export), filters, pagination consistency, validation 400s, CSV format and formula escaping, audit.exported row, seeded rows inside the date window, login_failed stores no identifier and recordSafe failure does not break the 401, db.sql+seed.sql loaded twice with v_grading_conflict = 0.

New .be-tmp/verify/browser-account.mjs and browser-audit.mjs with browser-lib.mjs helpers, as described in plan2.md section 9 (join page password fields and confirmation text, desk register, forced dialog in the three portals incl. Escape/overlay locked, change-password dialog in all three portals desktop + phone sheet, audit page as ADM-001 at 1280 and 390 incl. filters/search/pager/expand/CSV button, ADM-101 redirect + toast, nav item presence). Screenshots to .be-tmp/screens/ (audit-1280.png, audit-390.png, join-password.png, forced-dialog-*.png, change-password-*.png). Zero console errors and zero failed requests everywhere.

.be-tmp/verify/run-all.mjs: add the four suites to SUITES (new API suites after api-instructor, browser suites at the end); new static checks per plan2.md section 9; browser-login page list includes admin_portal/audit.html.

Docs: README.md (endpoints, env CHANGE_PW_RATE_MAX/CHANGE_PW_RATE_WINDOW_MS, auth/registration/forced-change/session-invalidation, grading-notes decision, audited and not-audited lists, demo-hash note), database/README.md (audit_log in the table list, schema changes for round 2, append-only trigger and DBA drop note, seed notes), .be-tmp/report.md section 11 decisions 1, 2, 8 and section 12 deferred list updated (note the date and that round 2 resolved them).
Run node .be-tmp/verify/run-all.mjs completely; fix failures at their cause (code or fixture), never by deleting assertions. Record suite counts and evidence in this file's findings.
acceptance_criteria: node .be-tmp/verify/run-all.mjs exits 0 with every old suite and the four new suites passing and all static checks passing
Old expectations changed only where a user decision changed behaviour (29/36, hidden grading notes, registration password, no tempPassword on activation)
README.md and database/README.md document the new endpoints, env vars, tables, trigger and decisions; database/README.md lists audit_log
Screenshots of the new/changed pages exist in .be-tmp/screens/
